summary: Houthi ballistic missile and drone strikes on Saudi-backed forces in Yemen's Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, and Al-Thaniya killed at least 60, while a senior Saudi official warned of imminent coordinated attacks on Saudi Arabia by Houthis, Iraqi resistance, and IRGC within 48 hours. Israel struck Hezbollah weapon depots and command centers in southern Lebanon after an IED in Majdal Zoun killed two reserve soldiers and wounded four. Oman and Iran finalized a temporary framework to reopen the Strait of Hormuz endorsed by GCC, as tanker traffic dropped 34% and Kuwait shut border oil wells anticipating attack.
key_points: Houthis claimed ballistic missile and drone strikes on Saudi-backed forces in Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, Al-Thaniya, killing 60 and wounding dozens. (Source: @mamlekate/104095, @kianmeli1/90685)
Senior Saudi official reported credible intelligence of Houthi-Iraqi resistance-IRGC coordination for attacks on Saudi Arabia within 48 hours. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78871)
IDF attacked Hezbollah weapon depots and command centers in southern Lebanon responding to Majdal Zoun IED that killed two reserve soldiers. (Source: @manniefabian/58940, @New_security8200/203235)
Oman and Iran agreed on a temporary framework to reopen Strait of Hormuz to commercial vessels, endorsed by GCC with UN IMO and US involvement expected. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6128)
Iranian cruise missiles targeted ships allegedly violating Strait passage guidelines as tanker traffic fell to 33 ships weekly from 50. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94091, @SharghDaily/176631)
Israeli patrol infiltrated Ain Zivan village in southern Quneitra, searching homes. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383249)
Explosion in Jaramana, Syria killed at least seven; Kuwait extinguished oil wells on Iraqi border anticipating attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/133679, @naya_foriraq/87159)
Israeli Navy conducted large-scale Mediterranean and Red Sea drill simulating multi-front combat and defense of gas rigs and ports. (Source: @manniefabian/58941)

sections.executive_summary: Houthi ballistic missile and drone strikes on Saudi-backed forces in Yemen's Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, and Al-Thaniya killed at least 60, while a senior Saudi official warned of imminent coordinated attacks on Saudi Arabia by Houthis, Iraqi resistance, and IRGC within 48 hours. Israel struck Hezbollah weapon depots and command centers in southern Lebanon after an IED in Majdal Zoun killed two reserve soldiers and wounded four. Oman and Iran finalized a temporary framework to reopen the Strait of Hormuz endorsed by GCC, as tanker traffic dropped 34% and Kuwait shut border oil wells anticipating attack.

points: Iran launched cruise missiles against vessels it claimed were violating Strait of Hormuz transit guidelines, marking a shift from mine-laying to direct kinetic enforcement of maritime rules. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94091)
Explosions were reported in Kashan, Iran, though no official cause or damage assessment was provided in open sources. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94090)
A low-flying passenger aircraft over eastern Tehran caused public panic, suggesting possible air defense readiness or unauthorized flight activity near the capital. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78881)

Trump stated the US controls the Strait of Hormuz via naval blockade, acknowledged munitions shortages prompting a $21 billion supplemental request, and highlighted unlimited Patriot and Tomahawk production. (Source: @VahidOnline/77767)

Iran's Foreign Ministry said the Oman-Iran joint announcement is in final stage provided "certain third parties" do not interfere, but the deal "in itself" does not guarantee Strait security. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6119)
A reported US-IRGC engagement in the Strait involving two explosions overnight was described as showing signs of serious agreement or surrender. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78876)

IDF struck Hezbollah weapon depots, command centers, and other infrastructure across southern Lebanon in retaliation for the Majdal Zoun IED that killed Maj. (res.) Harel Birenshtein and Sgt. Maj. (res.) Tamir Vaknin and seriously wounded four. (Source: @manniefabian/58940, @New_security8200/203235)

Hundreds of IDF artillery shells were discovered abandoned in an open area of the Upper Galilee for approximately ten days without security or military presence after a unit departed. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94089)

Israeli Navy executed a large-scale drill involving hundreds of sailors on missile boats, corvettes, submarines, and patrol vessels in both the Mediterranean and Red Sea, practicing maritime infiltration, multi-front combat, aerial threats, and defense of gas rigs, ports, and national infrastructure. (Source: @manniefabian/58941)

An Israeli military patrol infiltrated the Syrian village of Ain Zivan in southern Quneitra countryside and searched several homes, demonstrating continued operational freedom near the disengagement line. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383249)
US-sponsored Israel-Lebanon talks in Rome concluded without a breakthrough, leaving the ceasefire implementation mechanism unresolved. (Source: @presstv/201866)
No significant developments regarding Gaza or the West Bank were reported in the provided messages during this period.

IDF conducted retaliatory strikes on Hezbollah weapon depots, command centers, and terror infrastructure in multiple southern Lebanon sectors following the Majdal Zoun IED attack. (Source: @manniefabian/58940, @New_security8200/203235)
Artillery shelling was reported in the Lebanese villages of Mays al-Jabal and Adshit al-Qasir, indicating ongoing kinetic activity along the border. (Source: @redlinkleb/35118, @redlinkleb/35071)
US-sponsored Israel-Lebanon negotiations in Rome ended without a breakthrough, prolonging diplomatic deadlock over ceasefire enforcement. (Source: @presstv/201866)
Four reserve soldiers wounded in the Majdal Zoun incident were evacuated to Rambam Hospital; one regained consciousness while three remained sedated and ventilated. (Source: @pkpoi/143537)
Israeli occupation forces infiltrated Ain Zivan village in southern Quneitra countryside and searched several homes, per Syrian local sources. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383249)
An explosion in Jaramana, a Druze suburb south of Damascus, killed at least seven people; forensic teams processed body remnants at the scene. (Source: @yediotnews25/133679)
Helicopters were observed flying densely over Iraq's Karbala province, suggesting heightened aerial activity or security operations. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87176)
Kuwait extinguished oil wells on the Iraqi border as a precaution against a possible imminent attack. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87159)

A senior Saudi official stated credible intelligence indicates coordination between Houthis, Iraqi resistance factions, and IRGC to launch attacks on Saudi Arabia within 48 hours. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78871)

Houthi attacks on Saudi-backed mercenary positions in Al-Rawik and Marib, Yemen, using ballistic missiles and drones, reportedly killed at least 58-60 fighters and wounded dozens. (Source: @mamlekate/104095, @kianmeli1/90685, @presstv/201874)

Oman and Iran agreed on a temporary framework to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, endorsed by GCC members with UN IMO and US involvement expected for formal announcement. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6128)

Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif, and Turkish President Erdogan are scheduled to hold a summit in Jeddah with no official agenda released. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6129, @shin_persian/8867)
Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to 33 vessels in the Monday-Thursday period, down from 50 the previous week, per Kpler data. (Source: @SharghDaily/176631)
Kuwait preemptively shut down oil wells on the Iraqi border anticipating a potential attack. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87159)
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent expressed hope for an agreement with Iran in coming days, stating "we will get to the other side of this" and prices will fall. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78877)

key_developments: Houthi ballistic missile and drone strikes hit Saudi-backed force concentrations in Yemen's Al-Rawik, Al-Abr, Al-Thaniya, killing at least 60 and wounding dozens, per Houth
